## Why

The frozen P0–P5 snapshot ended before the six original HCSN fits became terminal. Their final outcomes, costs, models and failed partial work need an explicit append-only source chain.

## Changes

Add the 126-file follow-up package with original42 controller/launcher receipts, all six HCSN terminal reports, full archive identities and nine authenticated draft-asset readbacks. Retain independent snapshot, continuum-scope and baseline/C1 aggregate closures and the fixed terminal-model numerical plan.

All 42 original attempts are terminal. The original adequacy count is 26/42; separate C1 raises the baseline subset to 33/36. All six HCSN fits are budget-exhausted, with 46–47 complete epochs and no adequacy credit. Their 343–346 retained trace records are explicit truncated prefixes, not full training-domain evidence.

## Verification

- Four manifest sets and five current document entry points pass the file/hash/archive/link checker: 785 file entries, no errors.
- A separate check of Git objects exposed 15 ignored original log files across the old and new packages. The old tree fails with exactly those 15 omissions; the repaired tree passes all 785 byte identities. Original manifests and log bytes were not changed.
- The five earlier logs were appended to #5829 and merged into the protocol ancestry; this package includes all ten review logs.
- Local and remote complete tree match: `ca0908523c7abee3240677b95641c95e43168e34`.
- 28 archived payloads have retained full authenticated readback. One preliminary manifest has metadata-only status, and the original official-data starter remains explicitly incomplete.
- Numerical execution and fresh full-D replay have separate evidence; this archive does not grant their results or scientific benefit.

Stacked on #5830. CURRENT and its CI entrypoints are a separate small follow-up. Main and the unpublished release remain unchanged.
